comparison.objective: Use two battens to cradle a large ball onto a raised holder; candidate breaks and retrieves HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated two-tool support and level transport of a rolling object versus mandrel stabilization, controlled hammer strikes, withdrawal, and fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Ball ends in the holder after supported transport versus four contact-loaded fractures and four tangs in a tray with inserts and shell intact.
comparison.reason: Both are bimanual tool tasks, but distributed support transport and notch fracture test meaningfully different abilities. No separate spec versions were provided.
